clips.title: The story
paras: Deep within the irradiated ruins of Gnomeregan stands the Sparklematic 5200, an automated cleaning apparatus left behind during the city's evacuation. For a small fee of silver, this machine vigorously scrubs salvageable curiosities from the muck and radioactive sludge coating the fallen capital.

The Sparklematic 5200 represents the ingenious automated infrastructure gnomes installed throughout Gnomeregan before the trogg invasion and subsequent fallout. Even with toxic waste and hostile automatons filling the corridors, this contraption still performs its exact programming whenever provided with three silver coins and a grime-encrusted artifact.

When engaged, the Sparklematic lurches wildly while dousing and scrubbing the inserted relic in potent gnomish cleaning solvents. Once the cycle finishes with a cheerful chime, it dispenses a neatly packaged box containing whatever salvage was preserved beneath the corrosive trogg slime and toxic filth.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Sparklematic 5200 comes to life, lurching to and fro. Inside, the helpless grime that has encrusted the object placed within it is being pulverized by the machine's gnomish cleaning agent.
The Sparklematic 5200 comes to a halt, heralded by a familiar "ding!" The item receptacle of the machine spirals open, revealing a neatly wrapped box.
